name: Internally Displaced Persons (UNHCR-reported, end-year stock)
note: UNHCR's own IDP stock estimates (separate from IDMC); measures internal displacement in countries UNHCR has operational mandate

name: Media Self-Censorship
note: Journalist self-censorship due to political pressure

name: UNHCR IDP Stock Annual Change Rate (%, derived)
note: Percentage change in UNHCR-reported IDP stock year-on-year; acceleration of displacement crisis or recovery signal

name: GED One-Sided Violence Events Count (country-year aggregate)
note: Count of georeferenced one-sided violence events; civilian targeting frequency, atrocity event density

name: Military expenditure (current LCU)
note: Nominal military spending; defence budget context

name: Transparent Laws with Predictable Enforcement
note: Laws publicly known and consistently applied

name: Media Bias (Pro-Government)
note: Systematic pro-government bias in mainstream media

name: Print and Broadcast Media Perspectives Diversity
note: Diversity of political perspectives in media

name: GED Non-State Violence Events Count (country-year aggregate)
note: Count of georeferenced non-state conflict events in country-year; communal violence frequency signal

name: GED Geographic Spread (count of distinct ADM1 regions with events, country-year)
note: Number of distinct first-level administrative regions with GED events; spatial diffusion of conflict, territorial control signal

name: Number of Active One-Sided Violence Actors (country-year)
note: Count of distinct actors committing one-sided violence in country-year; plurality of targeting actors, repression breadth
